title: The 12 Best Gooseneck Kettles of 2026
metaDescription: Our 12 picks for gooseneck kettles of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at gooseneck kettles of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: OXO Brew Adjustable Temperature Pour-Over Kettle
products.blurb: Key specs: Variable temp, Gooseneck, Hold mode 30 min.
strengths: Precise temperature control, among the most precise in this category
Hold mode maintains set temperature during multi-cup sessions
Built-in timer for tracking bloom and pour time
Balanced gooseneck with controllable pour rate
limitations: 0.9L, limits to 2 to 3 cups per fill for large pour-over vessels
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package
